headline: Fuel prices jump: Fuel prices rise by Tk20 per litre across Bangladesh
summary: Diesel, petrol, kerosene, and octane prices have increased by Tk20 per litre starting Monday, following a government notification.
details: The prices of four types of fuel—diesel, kerosene, petrol, and octane—have increased by Tk20 per litre. The new rates, effective from Monday, September 21, are Tk135 for diesel, Tk155 for kerosene, Tk160 for petrol, and Tk165 for octane.
caption:
Fuel prices just jumped by Tk20 per litre across the country.

The prices of four types of fuel—diesel, kerosene, petrol, and octane—have increased by Tk20 per litre. The new rates, effective from Monday, September 21, are Tk135 for diesel, Tk155 for kerosene, Tk160 for petrol, and Tk165 for octane.

headline_marked: 7 killed as [[gas cylinder explosion rocks Ashulia garment factory]]
headline: 7 killed as gas cylinder explosion rocks Ashulia garment factory
summary: A massive blast in a covered van carrying cylinders caused a fire that destroyed multiple vehicles and injured at least 20 people.
details: At least seven people were killed and 20 others injured after a gas cylinder explosion occurred in a covered van within the premises of a garment factory in Ashulia, Savar.
The incident took place around 6:45 PM on Sunday at the Pretty Group factory in the Jamgora area. The blast occurred while cylinders were being unloaded from the van.
The explosion was so powerful that it shattered windows of the factory building and triggered a chain reaction, causing other cylinders to burst and spreading fire to 5-6 nearby vehicles.
One victim, 55-year-old Joynab, was killed instantly when a cylinder flew 200 yards away, pierced the tin roof of a tailor shop, and struck her head.
Fire service units arrived quickly to bring the blaze under control. Five additional bodies were later recovered from inside the covered van.
Ashulia Police Station OC Mohammad Torikul Islam confirmed the deaths and stated that an investigation into the cause of the accident is underway.
caption:
A gas cylinder blast in Ashulia killed 7 and injured 20, with one victim struck by a flying cylinder 200 yards away.

At least seven people were killed and 20 others injured after a gas cylinder explosion occurred in a covered van within the premises of a garment factory in Ashulia, Savar.

The incident took place around 6:45 PM on Sunday at the Pretty Group factory in the Jamgora area. The blast occurred while cylinders were being unloaded from the van.

The explosion was so powerful that it shattered windows of the factory building and triggered a chain reaction, causing other cylinders to burst and spreading fire to 5-6 nearby vehicles.

One victim, 55-year-old Joynab, was killed instantly when a cylinder flew 200 yards away, pierced the tin roof of a tailor shop, and struck her head.

Fire service units arrived quickly to bring the blaze under control. Five additional bodies were later recovered from inside the covered van.

Ashulia Police Station OC Mohammad Torikul Islam confirmed the deaths and stated that an investigation into the cause of the accident is underway.
